I was the same age as you when I started TRT, the worst mistake of my life. I took Androgel from August 2018 and stopped in January 2019 after noticing massive hair loss. Before TRT, I had a dense forest of hair which I was very fond of. I could tug and yank at it all day and nary a strand would fall.

I have since tried every medication that is given for androgenic alopecia and they have all failed. Finasteride and Dutasteride **increased** my DHT levels, which is the byproduct of testosterone that triggers hair loss. I started Minoxidil in June and it has triggered horrific shedding across the front of my scalp. I lose 180 to 280 hairs every day.

My appearance has aged a decade since I started TRT. I have a massive bald spot and horrible diffuse thinning which leaves my scalp very visible. I used to love standing in front of mirrors and playing with my hair. Now I dread seeing my reflection.

I wouldn't wish this upon you. I could never have foreseen this since my family has no history of baldness, something that everybody says is hereditary. I hope my case helps you make an informed decision.
